extracted.name: Honey Banana Muffins
extracted.description: These are a favorite when I bake them for my crew.
instruction_lines: Heat unsalted butter in medium skillet until melted on medium heat. Add pecans, sugar, and 1/4 tsp cinnamon. Toast for approximately 7 min. Set aside.
Combine flour, baking soda, cinnamon, & salt in separate bowl. Set aside.
Mash bananas until smooth. Using a hand mixer (or a stand mixer fixed with the paddle) mix honey, oil, vanilla & egg with banana mixture.
Add flour mixture to banana mixture until just combined.
Scoop approximately 1/4 Cup muffin batter into muffin liners. Top with toasted pecans. Makes 10-12 Muffins.
Bake for 20 min. Inserted toothpick should come out clean.
